title: Imify
subtitle: The Powerful Image Toolkit
aboutText1: Imify was born out of a simple need: <1>Privacy-First</1> image processing. Unlike online converters that upload your data to remote servers, Imify handles every single byte <2>locally</2> right in your browser memory.
aboutText2: Built for developers, designers, and privacy enthusiasts who need quick, reliable, and secure image formatting without compromise.
